recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, high-energy layout dominated by a bright yellow background. It features a group of men in casual-to-smart attire standing in a staggered formation, casting long, soft shadows. The composition is anchored by massive, condensed sans-serif title text that interacts with metallic zipper elements, suggesting a 'reveal' or 'stripping' theme.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale typography layered behind and in front of subjects
Zipper graphics acting as framing devices and conceptual metaphors
Long diagonal shadows grounding subjects in a flat color space
Primary color palette (Yellow, Blue, Red) creating high visual impact
coreInvariants: Full-body character photography with realistic shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Ensemble cast positioned in the lower two-thirds, staggered in depth with the central figure largest in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive blue 'MONTY' text block in the center-top serves as the primary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-right zipper, follow the diagonal title down to the central figure, and then across the secondary cast members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample yellow negative space at the top and sides to allow the bold elements to breathe.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crimson Red (Secondary Title and Zipper Interior)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary colors with high value contrast against the yellow.

letterConstructionRules: Vertical stress with extremely narrow proportions
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' in the secondary title is tilted and interacts with a zipper puller
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pairing a massive condensed display face with a smaller, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative 90s feel.
Provides the necessary verticality and weight variations.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid bright yellow background. Place a group of 5-6 men in 90s British casual attire (leather jackets, jeans, sweaters) in a staggered V-formation. Add long, soft shadows stretching towards the bottom-left. In the top right corner, add a realistic metallic zipper partially unzipped to reveal red fabric underneath.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in an ultra-condensed blue sans-serif font, centered and large. Add a secondary title in red, slightly tilted, with a zipper puller hanging from one of the letters. Place metadata text at the bottom in a small, bold, wide-tracked sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the background a flat, vibrant yellow?
Are the shadows long and consistent with a single light source?
Does the typography overlap or interact with the zipper graphic?
Is the main title font extremely tall and narrow?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the zipper looks metallic and integrated
Check that the blue text is behind the foreground figure but in front of the background
Verify the yellow is consistent and not a gradient
Confirm the bottom text is legible against the yellow
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid yellow field + staggered cast + long shadows + massive condensed blue type + metallic zipper motif.
